VGW's own job page for its Perth role (https://www.vgw.co/greencon_job/application-support-specialist-4/) links "Apply Now" to https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/vgw-australia/jobs/8883252002, a posting on this Australian board, whose public feed lists it (read in a browser 2026-11-13; sources.json "vgw-greenhouse-jobs"). Only the Australian board is approved, not VGW's global one.

VGW's global Greenhouse board "vgw". VGW's own job page links to it from a generic "Apply Now" button, but it is not the Australian board (that one, "vgw-australia", is approved: the page's Perth role links to it). It is not polled: the directory is Australian roles, and a person decides whether the global board has anything to add.
